citations.claim: initial position just outside wall with 0.1 clearance
speed ~55.6 makes displacement ~1.77m > wall thickness 0.2 + gap
first violating step center crosses to other side of wall, now at x=5.24

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0319 to 0.001 to reduce per-step displacement below wall thickness, preventing tunneling

explanation: Body 0 starts 0.1m from wall 0 (wall x=5.5 w=0.2, body x=6.3 r=0.5) with speed ~55.6 m/s and dt=0.0319 => displacement ~1.77m, much larger than wall thickness 0.2m and initial clearance. Even with 60 substeps (substep ~0.53ms, travel ~0.03m per substep still less than wall but CCD logic appears to miss centre crossing through thin axis-aligned box). Body centre goes from x=6.3 to x=5.242, y 3.4 to 1.97, ending on opposite side of wall with centre-inside-box traversal between steps 0 and 1. Reducing dt to 0.001 makes displacement ~0.055m, no tunneling, confirming cause is inadequate continuous collision detection for high-speed traversal of thin wall at large dt.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 0 and 1

vision_note: In step 0 the red ball is clearly on the right side of the thin vertical wall, just separated from it. In step 1 it appears on the left/bottom side of the same wall, having crossed through it between frames.
